nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm JPEG fresh Stream decode FFmpeg worker

receipt.boundary: Fresh non-exposed seekable JPEG Stream with complete input acquisition, all buffering/copies and EOF checks to independent owned RGBA8. Native fresh AVIO and owned packet acquisition/release execute every operation. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, full-range BT.601 conversion, owned output allocation and release. For subsampled inputs, expand both ceil-sized chroma planes by their sampling factors and crop to the original grid inside every operation, including intermediate acquisition/release. Grayscale includes expanding owned decoded GRAY8 samples into independent RGBA8 inside every operation. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.
